name: zk-circuits
description: Zero-Knowledge circuits for GitHub eligibility verification

scripts.setup: snarkjs groth16 setup build/github_eligibility.r1cs powersOfTau28_hez_final_12.ptau build/github_eligibility_0000.zkey
scripts.contribute: snarkjs zkey contribute build/github_eligibility_0000.zkey build/github_eligibility_final.zkey --name="1st Contributor" -v
scripts.export-vkey: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/github_eligibility_final.zkey build/verification_key.json
scripts.export-verifier: snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier build/github_eligibility_final.zkey contracts/src/Verifier.sol
